t: 方济会会士吉罗拉莫·马斯奇被选为教皇,选择了尼古拉斯四世的名字.
te: The Franciscan Girolamo Maschi is elected pope, choosing the name Nicholas IV.
dz: 方济会会士吉罗拉莫·马斯奇被选为教皇,选择了尼古拉斯四世的名字.
de: The Franciscan Girolamo Maschi is elected pope, choosing the name Nicholas IV.

t: 袁军在今越南北部的巴赫当战役被特伦部队击败.
te: Yuan forces are defeated by Trần forces in the Battle of Bach Dang in present-day northern Vietnam.
dz: 蒙古入侵越南:袁军在今越南北部的巴赫当战役被特伦部队击败.
de: Mongol invasions of Vietnam: Yuan forces are defeated by Trần forces in the Battle of Bach Dang in present-day northern Vietnam.

dz: 沃林根战役结束了林堡继承战争,布拉班特公爵约翰一世是更重要的胜利者之一.
de: The Battle of Worringen ends the War of the Limburg Succession, with John I, Duke of Brabant, being one of the more important victors.
